summary: Kerb backing onto bushy parkland, cars park here, houses across the road.
reasons: North side is bush and park

drivers.seclusion: Own side is wooded park; nearest dwellings 17 m or more, across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars already parked on this kerb; room for a van beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street running off a busier road.
drivers.convention: Signed P (No Limit) parallel; cars park along the kerb.

Apartments 15 m from the start of the stretch
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy from the north side shades most of the section.
